## Checklist

- [ ] `tests/ci_local.sh` passes (or CI is green)
- [ ] A new or renamed parameter is in `documentation/params.md`, in the A-Z table and its section
- [ ] A new step or process is in `README.md` and `graph.md`, and has a `stub:` block
- [ ] A change in which tasks run is reflected in `tests/stub/expected/` (`tests/stub/run.sh --update`), and the diff is what I meant
- [ ] A new script ships with a `*_test` next to it
- [ ] New container images are pinned to a version tag
